title: Mucho
summary: A studio or agency in Barcelona since 2002. It builds visual systems from a clear idea, typography and editorial thinking, with close attention to everyday applications.

hero_image.alt: A plastered studio room where two people confer at a small desk, a long table in front of them covered with pattern studies, mark sketches and printed proofs.
hero_image.caption: Two people and one table: identity argued between collaborators before it is shown to anyone.
